text:
Sam (Finance): Month-end flag: invoice 7890 (Nimbus Labs) prepaid Dedicated capacity for $240,000 received 2026-02-20. Need deferral schedule and treatment of the 10% implementation credit bundled in the contract. Also FP&A flagged a small usage refund accrual for late-Feb trials (~$2,300). Can owners confirm treatment by EOD so we can close books.

Oliver (Revenue Ops): I can draft the deferral. Contract term per SOW is 24 months starting 2026-03-01. Recommendation: gross contract consideration $240kdefer and recognize straight-line over 24 months. For the 10% implementation credit ($24k) we should treat as a customer incentive that reduces net transaction price; amortize the net over the same 24-month service period. Thoughts @Priya @Liam?

Priya (Acctg): Agree with deferral mapping. Initial receipt JE recorded as:
``
Dr Cash 1010 $240,000
Cr Deferred Revenue 2201 $240,000
``
We will create a second liability for the implementation credit: Customer Credit (2305) $24,000. Monthly entries when recognizing revenue will be:
``
Dr Deferred Revenue 2201 $10,000
Dr Customer Credit 2305 $1,000
Cr Revenue 4001 $9,000
``
This nets to $9k recognized monthly and consumes $1k of credit liability per month. Also note any implementation services that are distinct should be accounted separately if present.

Liam (FP&A): The refund accrual: based on usage logs and support tickets, estimate $2,300 of trial credits that will be applied in March. Recommend accrual for Feb P&L:
``
Dr Marketing Promotions 6XXX $2,300
Cr Accrued Liabilities 2109 $2,300
```
Reverse in March when actual credits post. I ran sensitivity; upper bound $3.5k, lower bound $1.1k. Picked midpoint.

Sam (Finance): Quick question on presentation: do we present the $24k credit as contra-revenue or as separate operating expense (sales/marketing)? Controller prefers contra-revenue to keep gross ARR metrics consistent; auditors asked for clear disclosure. @Priya any preference?

Priya (Acctg): Contra-revenue is appropriate here since it's a price concession tied to the contract. We'll document in the revenue memo and attach contract excerpt. If we had a separate third-party marketing fee, it'd be expense.

close-bot: Payment recorded: Stripe pay_9KzA... amount $240,000 posted 2026-02-20 09:45 UTC. Bank feed reconciled.

Oliver (Revenue Ops): Draft schedule uploaded to Deferrals sheet: shows gross $10k/mo, credit $1k/mo, net $9k/mo for 24 months (total net $216k). Link: //drive/redwood/deferrals/7890_schedule.csv

Priya (Acctg): JE for Feb accrual and deferral adjustments scheduled to post in next close batch. JE refs: JE-2026-0301 (deferral), JE-2026-0302 (refund accrual).

Sam (Finance): Thanks team. Action items: @Oliver finalize and attach schedule to invoice record; @Priya post JEs and note audit backup; @Liam keep comments on sensitivity. Please confirm once done. Close aim: EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Acctg): Done 1: JE-2026-0301 and JE-2026-0302 posted. Attachments saved to Close/Feb/JEs.

Oliver (Revenue Ops): Final schedule attached to deferrals sub-ledger.

Liam (FP&A): Noted and saved sensitivity file in Close/Feb/usage_refunds.xlsx.

Sam (Finance): Closing loop 1: thanks everyone, will include these in auditor packet.
